_README: Manual corrections for DEBATE press-sentiment mislabels. Applied in make_member_desk press loading: overrides the displayed stance/label/direction for matching articles. Match each correction by 'url' (exact) OR 'title_contains' (case-insensitive substring). 'stance' is one of: support | oppose | neutral (support=pro-CU/+, oppose=anti-CU/-, neutral=0). Add entries to 'corrections' and regenerate (make_member_desk.py -> make_combined.py) to apply. NOTE: this corrects the member-desk DISPLAY; correcting the press PILLAR/ranks additionally needs the upstream press_value re-flowed (cu_press_stance_tone.csv -> Press Release - Raw).
